transcript_path.description: Path to the conversation JSON. Written asynchronously, so it can lag the current turn; on Stop and SubagentStop read last_assistant_message instead.

cwd.description: Working directory when the hook is invoked. Follows Claude into a worktree or after a cd, while CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR stays at the project root where the session started.

prompt_id.description: UUID of the user prompt being processed; matches the prompt.id attribute on OpenTelemetry events. Absent until the first user input.

scratchpad_dir.description: Path to the session's scratchpad directory. Absent when the session has none or the temp directory is unavailable. Claude Code 2.1.257 or later.

permission_mode.description: Current permission mode. The mode labelled Manual arrives as default. Not every event carries this field.

level.description: The effort level that ran, including a skill's, subagent's or ultrathink level. CLAUDE_EFFORT holds the same value.

effort.description: Present on events with a tool-use context, on models that support effort.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the subagent or in-process teammate the hook fires in.

agent_type.description: Agent name, such as Explore or a plugin-scoped my-plugin:reviewer. Present inside a subagent, or when the session runs with --agent; a subagent's type wins over the session's.

tool_name.description: The tool being called: a built-in such as Bash, PowerShell, Edit, Write, Read, Glob, Grep, Agent, WebFetch or WebSearch, or an MCP tool named mcp__<server>__<tool> (mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__<tool> for a plugin's own server).

tool_input.description: The arguments sent to the tool. The keys depend on the tool; see the tool-input schemas beside this file.

tool_response.description: What the model receives for this call: a serialized string or a content-block array, not the structured object PostToolUse gets.

tool_calls.description: Every tool call in the batch.

title: PostToolBatch hook input
description: Every tool call in a batch of parallel calls has resolved, before the next model request. Fires once per batch. No matcher.
